keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.help: Notify a channel when a message holds a word or phrase, in addition to the usual notifications. A channel that already receives the message does not get it twice. A keyword never makes a notification urgent, and muted, blocked and paused conversations stay silent. Web Push reaches administrators’ devices only, without the message text on a device whose owner may not read it.
keywords.forgery: Anyone in range can write a keyword in a channel: channel messages are not authenticated, so a message that matches may be forged. Do not rely on a keyword alone for anything critical. Each rule has a cooldown, and the same sender cannot trigger the same rule again within 15 minutes.
keywords.dialogHelp: Text is compared without regard to case. No regular expressions.
keywords.channelsHelp: Web Push reaches administrators’ devices only.
keywords.cooldownHelp: After a match, the rule stays quiet for this long, whoever writes. 0 turns the rule cooldown off; a sender still has to wait at least 15 minutes.
